# Hyperspectral_HYU developer rules

Only develop the requested track (싱글/멀티/연속); shared B17 physics in 공통/ must remain consistent. Original B17 hash validation mandatory. Full grids 3800/1429/512/3000; 440–660 nm; object and metasurface phase [0,2π); GD100 + L-BFGS100 and circular prior .015 for fixed single benchmark. Do not change geometry, data, objective or iteration budget silently. No truth/labels in inverse. Separate generation, recovery, evaluation. Never fabricate results or treat a plan/forward as recovery. Record exact command, hashes, metrics and status in docs. Keep old historical benchmark separate from new performance. Do not overwrite existing run outputs. No old failed code in active default path. Read docs/RESEARCH_PROGRESS.md and docs/REPRODUCTION.md before work.
